dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250315-MOZ-01](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250315-MOZ-01) A flood occurred on Mar 15 2025 in Mozambique. It affected an estimated 436040 people and 49593 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
